name: Cambricon MLU590 (Siyuan 590) training accelerator
memory_bandwidth_basis: NOT VENDOR-PUBLISHED. Cambricon has NOT published an official MLU590 datasheet or product page. The ~192 GB HBM2e and ~2.4 TB/s figures come from mutually inconsistent brokerage/analyst notes aggregated by flopper.io and awesomeagents.ai. The flopper.io spec sheet shows all dashes (no data). Treat as contested analyst estimates, not vendor specifications.
notes: THE HIERARCHY POINT: this record is CONTESTED and low-confidence because Cambricon has published NO official MLU590 datasheet or product page. Every circulating number comes from mutually inconsistent brokerage/analyst notes. The flopper.io spec sheet — normally reliable for vendor-published specs — shows all dashes for this part. WHAT ANALYSTS REPORT: ~192 GB HBM2e at ~2.4 TB/s, TSMC 7nm, 350-550 W TDP, ~512 TOPS INT8, ~80 TFLOPS FP32. These figures are recorded with vendor_claim: false because they are analyst estimates, not vendor specifications. The MLU590 is described as Cambricon's training flagship, positioned against the NVIDIA A100. It uses the MLUarch05 architecture. The part is significant because it represents Cambricon's attempt to move from the MLU370's LPDDR5-based inference position to an HBM2e-based training position — a major architectural shift. However, without a vendor datasheet, every figure here should be treated as provisional. The TDP range (350-550 W) is particularly uncertain. Vendor is 'cambricon' (in the schema enum).
